_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Communications market = hero AI datacom 800G/1.6T, Networking segment = pillar AI/cloud, Total Rev, Materials & Lasers en bas. FY end juin.

kpis.signal: Explosion FY25 (+51%) sur AI datacom 800G/1.6T transceivers + VCSELs, hero AI infrastructure
kpis.description_fr: Revenus du marche Communications (Datacom AI/ML + Telecom). Hero AI transceivers optiques 800G/1.6T pour datacenters hyperscale. ~59% des revenus FY25.
kpis.description_en: Communications market revenue (Datacom AI/ML + Telecom). AI optical transceivers hero (800G/1.6T) for hyperscale datacenters. ~59% of FY25 revenue.

kpis.signal: Segment #1 (~59% CA FY25), boom sur AI optics, marge en expansion (segment profit 643M vs 354M)
kpis.description_fr: Composants, modules et sous-systemes semi-conducteurs III-V pour communications optiques + datacom AI. Concentre sur communications (~97%).
kpis.description_en: III-V compound semiconductor components, modules, subsystems for optical communications + AI datacom. Concentrated in communications (~97%).

kpis.signal: Step-up FY23 (Coherent Inc acquisition juillet 2022), rebond FY25 AI optics apres trou FY24
kpis.description_fr: CA total consolide. Saut FY23 lie a l'acquisition Coherent Inc (juillet 2022). FY end 30 juin.
kpis.description_en: Total consolidated revenue. FY23 step-up from Coherent Inc acquisition (July 2022). FY ends June 30.

kpis.signal: Declin continu 2 ans, faiblesse Electronics (SiC pour vehicules, EUV optics) + restructuration en cours
kpis.description_fr: Materiaux ingenieres et dispositifs optoelectroniques (ZnSe, ZnS, GaAs, InP, GaSb, SiC). Expose marches Electronics et Industrial.
kpis.description_en: Engineered materials and optoelectronic devices (ZnSe, ZnS, GaAs, InP, GaSb, SiC). Electronics and Industrial markets exposure.

kpis.signal: Segment heritage Coherent Inc (acquis juillet 2022), stabilise apres trou Industrial 2024
kpis.description_fr: Lasers et optiques pour applications industrielles (decoupage, soudage) et instrumentation scientifique. Segment cree apres acquisition Coherent Inc juillet 2022.
kpis.description_en: Lasers and optics for industrial applications (cutting, welding) and scientific instrumentation. Segment created after July 2022 Coherent Inc acquisition.
